title: Answer to Question: The Repercussions of the American Presidential Elections
text:
Answer to Question

The Repercussions of the American Presidential Elections

Question:

The American presidential elections this time were accompanied by tensions between President Trump and his Democratic rival Biden. Then Biden won, as the news media announced, and Trump did not recognise the result. So are the tensions that accompanied the elections on their way to calming down after Biden's victory? And is a smooth transfer of power taking place in Washington? Or does the course of affairs have consequences further-reaching and more dangerous than that, at home and abroad?

Answer:

Almost everyone this time is agreed that these presidential elections in America are unprecedented. They were accompanied by severe tension, and the American President Trump described the possibility of his losing the elections as something that could only happen in the event of fraud, and this was months before the elections. His insistence on keeping the post of the presidency was visible to the eye, to the degree that politicians in Washington were discussing how to deal with Trump in the event that he refused to leave the White House! Accordingly, it is important to explain the circumstances that preceded the elections and then those that followed them, and they are as follows:

First: Immediately upon taking power on 20/1/2017 CE, Trump began to act at home and abroad in a provocative, remarkable way:

1- As for at home, the President paid no heed to all his opponents, and change by dismissal or resignation was the prominent feature of the pillars of his administration. The ministers and directors of his administration changed more than once within four years, and he is still dealing with the same mentality... He dismissed his Defence Secretary Mark Esper on 9/11/2020 CE, that is, after the announcement of Biden's victory in the elections. And in the subject of the American police's racist treatment of Americans of African origin and the fierce demonstrations that broke out against it, Trump rejected all calls to put pressure on the police or reduce its budget, and his statements carried the smell of racism in a veiled way, and sometimes not veiled. And he cut taxes for companies greatly, under the pretext of creating job opportunities!

2- As for abroad, he ignited an economic war with China and inaugurated a new era for America of the policy of economic protectionism. He withdrew from international agreements such as the Paris climate agreement and NAFTA for trade in North America, and withdrew from numerous international organisations such as the World Health Organisation. He disowned his allies such as the Europeans, standing openly with Britain to help in taking it out of the European Union, promising it a big trade agreement, and he attacked the NATO states, demanding more spending from them... etc. Likewise he dealt with great contempt with the agents and followers of America in the Islamic region...

Second: How America became divided: when the Trump administration began to make sharp turns, the symptoms of many diseases appeared in America and floated clearly to the surface during the administration's four years:

1- President Trump, since his election campaign in 2016, showed racist tendencies that quickly found favour with large segments, and white supremacist groups appeared. They existed before Trump, but they revived and flourished during his rule. The "white" police killed black men, so America became divided between white and black. The "Black Lives Matter" group appeared as a political group that demonstrates, mobilises and calls for demands and equality, and in contrast armed militias of whites appeared in a more organised way and began preparing to destabilise...

2- The Trump administration showed contempt for the European allies, so much so that his Defence Secretary Mattis announced his resignation and wrote in his letter "Allies must be treated with respect" (Youm7, 21/12/2018 CE).

3- The American President Trump, since taking the presidency in 2017, called for the protectionist economic policy, that is, protecting the American economy from the Chinese and European products invading his country, and stopping the series of factory closures due to their inability to compete under international free trade. Trump was looking with one eye, without his other eye seeing that by that he was making fierce enemies for himself at home. The technology companies were among his fiercest enemies; they stood strongly against him, brought out thousands of their employees to demonstrate against him on numerous issues, and drew against him the weapon of embarrassing leaks. That is because these companies are global by the nature of their work; they do not want barriers, nor do they want other states to impose barriers on them as a response to Trump's policy. When China began to threaten to impose barriers on those companies, whose mouths water for the large Chinese market, and France began to demand that they pay taxes on their French revenues, those companies resolved to get rid of President Trump. So they were the cornerstone in the campaigns opposing Trump, and they were at the heart of Joe Biden's election campaign.

4- The world was talking about public health, prevention and protecting people from the corona virus, while the American President, in his capitalist outlook, was focusing on talking about medicine, the vaccine, the commercial race, the huge profits for whoever produces the medicine, and patent rights. So he appeared as if he lacked any outlook of looking after people's affairs (ri'ayah). Then the American President opposed closing the country to confront the corona virus, and his pretext was the economy. A war of harshly worded statements flared up between the Democratic leaders in the states and President Trump over closing the states to confront the corona virus. Trump was on the side of the oil, manufacturing and retail companies, which want to run the economy, and others, among them the leaderships of the Democratic Party, by way of opposition against him, stood on the side of closing the economy, using as a pretext the state of panic and terror that spread as a result of the corona virus. But behind closing the economy, behind those calling for it and behind Trump's opponents, there stood parties that did not appear in public. Those parties are the technology and artificial intelligence companies, which are growing continuously, indeed in a way unprecedented in the history of the economy. When the corona virus came and people around the world sat behind small screens in their homes and economised on their other expenditures, that turned into a fantastic increase in the capital of the technology companies. The e-commerce companies, the most famous of them "Amazon", saw their profits and market values jump to levels that were not anticipated, so much so that one of them (the founder of the Amazon company) gained six billion dollars in 24 hours as a result of the rise in the market value of his company. (The giant American technology companies announced the recording of huge profits totalling 38 billion dollars in the third quarter of this year. BBC, 30/10/2020.) These astronomical profits achieved by the companies Amazon, Apple, Alphabet, the owner of Google, Facebook, the companies of Elon Musk and other giants of American technology arouse the fury of the companies losing under the corona virus especially, such as the oil and energy companies, and the tourism companies in which the American President himself invests, from his tower in New York to his resort in Florida to his sports investments in Britain, which have also been affected by the corona virus.

Third: The American elections and fraud:

1- The 2020 presidential elections in America were not like those before them, since the announcement of the winner was delayed by nearly a week, because of the continuing counting of the votes by post, through which the Democrats mostly voted. President Trump, months before the date of the elections, rejected voting by post and said that it is a big door to fraud, and he asked his supporters to vote directly. The Democrats were demanding the expansion of absentee voting (by post) and the removal of all legal obstacles before this kind of voting, and this was closer to cunning than to being fraud.

2- As for its being cunning: the supporters of the Democratic Party do not take part fully in ordinary voting, and by that the party loses some votes. When the corona virus came, the party could have lost many votes were it not for absentee voting. Trump does not suffer from this problem, since his supporters vote for him solidly and in a way close to being by principle, and they do not stay away. That is why approving the expansion of absentee voting under the pretexts of corona was a great blessing for the Democratic Party. And indeed the results announced on the first day leaned decisively towards Trump, but when the swing states began counting the absentee votes, the electoral curve began to lean greatly in favour of the Democrat Biden. Such results were expected. In Philadelphia, the capital of the state of Pennsylvania, Biden's supporters were celebrating outside the main counting centre even though Trump was still ahead of Biden by a hundred thousand votes, because they expected that the remaining absentee votes were sufficient to turn things round in Biden's favour, and that is what actually happened, so that the media announced Biden's victory in this swing state, which enabled him to announce victory in the elections, since the votes of Pennsylvania were sufficient to bring him to the required number (270 votes) in the Electoral College.

Fourth: Where are matters heading today:

1- The winning candidate is making almost daily statements confirming his victory in the elections, such as his announcements of health briefings regarding corona, and such as the imposition of a no-fly zone over his house in his capacity as the winning candidate. He receives domestic and international congratulatory messages and contacts world leaders in his capacity as the elected and coming President of the United States. As for Trump, he has not recognised his victory and considers that the election campaign is going on in full swing through the lawsuits that will turn matters over, and he says that Biden has been hasty in announcing his victory without evidence that he won with legal votes... Andrew Bates, the spokesman of the Biden campaign, hinted that Trump would be taken out of the White House by force, and called him a trespasser!

2- The situation in America today is of high danger, and the German Defence Minister described it as "very explosive". Some were expecting armed militias of Trump's supporters to storm the counting centres and spread chaos. This has not happened to a great degree, although it appeared in some states, and it seems that it is postponed as long as the President hopes for a second term by way of lawsuits and political games.

On the other side, Al Jazeera Net reported on 10/11/2020 CE from the "Washington Post" newspaper that the White House "ordered the federal agencies to avoid cooperating with the transition team of the President-elect Joe Biden". The Trump administration refused to disburse sums of money that American law approves for the winning candidate to rent offices and other expenses. Trump said on 10/11/2020 CE in a tweet on Twitter: "The election results will begin to appear next week and we will win them." And his Secretary of State Pompeo spoke of a second term for Trump, and a Republican senator responded to him that this is a very dangerous statement from a government official. Thus the United States has come to live an actual crisis threatening its stability and the unity of its territory, and it may develop to become a serious threat. The states of the West Coast, especially California, which have been Democratic states for a long time and contain the headquarters of the technology companies, cannot accept a second term for Trump. As for the Republican states, especially Texas in the south, which is a force counterbalancing the state of California and contains the major American oil and energy companies, they do not accept the victory of the President-elect Biden, who threatens them that immediately upon taking power he will sign an executive order for the return of the United States to the Paris climate agreement... As for Trump, he threatens that if he obtains a second term he will never be tolerant towards the technology companies, which have greatly lowered his standing and blocked his tweets!

Fifth: The conclusion is that what is happening in the United States deserves to be paused at, and its course and events deserve careful consideration:

1- The democracy that America has long sung the praises of is being demolished today openly, under judicial and legal pretexts, to lessen the enormity of what President Trump is doing to keep power. America is open to all possibilities and to acts of revenge. The next president may be the winning candidate Biden, and it may be the losing candidate, the current President Trump, keeping a second term. Whoever the next president is, he will take revenge on the other side, a revenge closer to breaking bones than to twisting the arm. By that America is heading towards chaos and immersion in internal concerns and problems. Not excluded from that is the scenario of putting America on the road to disintegration, in which Texas would be a centre for Trump, the Republicans and the supporting companies, and in which California would be another centre for Biden, the Democrats and the supporting companies. This is not limited to the two months remaining of this term of Trump; rather it will continue after that...

2- The evils of the democratic capitalist system are rooted in it, and whoever examines it with a seeing eye and a heeding ear will see that clearly... The most prominent value in the democratic capitalist system is benefit (naf'iyyah), that is, material interest, and this is decided, directly or indirectly, by the President according to his powers and the influence of his party in the representative councils. That is why the decisions that determine the degree of benefit and its type differ from one president to another. With this president it achieves benefit according to his desire, so he issues a positive decision on it, and with another president, before him or after him, it does not agree with his desire, indeed it is harmful, so it is prevented or cancelled, while each of them asserts that he is implementing the democratic capitalist system and is committed to the man-made constitution, and each goes according to his own whim!

For example, immediately upon taking power on 20/1/2017, the then new President Trump began to demolish sharply what the Obama administration had built. He cancelled the health insurance "Obamacare", withdrew from the Paris climate agreement, and this was in favour of the American oil and energy companies, rejected any calls to regulate the carrying of arms in America, and tried to impose many restrictions on American technology companies, such as electronic surveillance, and tried to make them leave China... etc. All of this is contrary to the president before him, Obama, and contrary to his electoral rival Biden, who declares exactly the opposite of this. He supports health insurance and tries to regulate the carrying of arms, and Biden announces a policy of principle for his party and his country, if he takes power, of returning to climate change policies, that is, opposing the interests of the oil companies, and indeed imposing more taxes on them, those taxes which Trump had reduced. This puts him, and the technology companies behind him, in a sharp struggle with the oil and energy companies, as well as the arms companies, from which Biden plans to collect most of the state's budget... etc. It should be known that the biggest American oil companies are concentrated in Texas, while the biggest technology companies are concentrated in Silicon Valley in California, and this has been reflected in the view of each of the Republican and Democratic parties towards Texas and California!

Thus the interests of the capitalists, owners of the technology companies, which want openness and "globalism", collide with the oil, industry and agriculture companies, which want protection from Chinese competition to stop the haemorrhage of their losses... And the presidents and their helpers support these companies or those according to the measure of benefit which they see as achieving their interests, even if their rivals see it as harmful! And each of those of benefit and those of harm says that he is implementing the capitalist system. It is enough evil for this system that the two opposites (benefit and harm) are equal in it according to the desires of those who implement it!

3- As for why these evils did not appear glaringly in the United States except in the circumstance of these two rivals, Trump and Biden, it is for three reasons:

The first: each of the two rivals, the winner and the loser, has a wide public of people supporting him, benefiting from his benefit, for benefit is the greatest value in capitalism... At the same time, if the rival becomes the president, then the back-breaking blow will take the place of the benefit, and in this there is what there is.

The second: the systems prevailing in the world are the capitalist systems, and they are worse than the American system. That is why any comparison the American citizen makes with the other systems, he finds the evils of the system he has less than the evils of the other systems, so he accepts what he has and sees it as the lesser of two harms!

The third: there is no correct system standing in the face of America and the capitalist system such that it becomes clear to them how the truth is in contrast to their false system. If the system of Islam were implemented on earth, filling it with good and blessing, justice and tranquillity, the people's confidence in the capitalist system would be shaken and they would look towards the good in the Khilafah State, the State of Islam, the State of La ilaha illa Allah Muhammad Rasool Allah (saw).

Finally we say: if falsehood has one round, then the truth has rounds and rounds, especially as the Ummah has a party, Hizb ut Tahrir, which joins its night to its day until the dawn of the Khilafah breaks anew, and the thrones of the tyrants in the East and the West come crashing down. And Allah the Almighty spoke the truth: "And these days [of varying conditions] We alternate among the people so that Allah may make evident those who believe and [may] take to Himself from among you martyrs - and Allah does not like the wrongdoers - And that Allah may purify the believers [through trials] and destroy the disbelievers."

5th of Rabi' al-Akhir 1442 AH

20/11/2020 CE
